verdict.rationale: Docs describe scheduled runs (morning PR reviews, overnight CI analysis, weekly dependency audits) and trigger-based automation via MCP channels reacting to Telegram/Discord/webhooks 'while you're away', plus CI/CD and Slack-triggered PR workflows — directly matching the always-on scheduled/triggered autonomy story. However, community reports raise serious doubts about trusting it to run unsupervised: users describe destructive self-inflicted bugs from unverified replace_all edits, inability to self-verify, and marked quality degradation over time, undercutting claims of reliably maintaining/fixing software autonomously.
